name: badge
title: Badge
description: Counts and "new" notification badges for collections, navbars and lists.
improvements: The caption ("new" or your own) is real text, so screen readers announce "4 new" instead of just "4".
Uses inline-flex instead of float: right, so badges align in any flex row without clearfix hacks.
Theme colors (secondary, primary, error, success) that follow dark mode.
